title: nardus stricta var. glabriculmis
intro: Nardus stricta var. glabriculmis, commonly known as Sea Spurge or more specifically, as a variety of the Nardus stricta plant, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Juncaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, wounds, and skin irritations, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sea Spurge are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Nardus stricta var. glabriculmis include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
